description: Defines the class ProtoTransportPayloadConfiguration which manages protobuf schema configurations for device telemetry, attributes, and RPC messages, including methods to retrieve descriptors and default schemas.

classes.name: ProtoTransportPayloadConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for protobuf transport payloads, providing schema management and descriptor retrieval.

methods.name: getTransportPayloadType
methods.description: Returns the transport payload type, which is PROTOBUF.

methods.name: getTelemetryDynamicMessageDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the protobuf descriptor for telemetry schema.

methods.name: getAttributesDynamicMessageDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the protobuf descriptor for attributes schema.

methods.name: getRpcResponseDynamicMessageDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the protobuf descriptor for RPC response schema.

methods.name: getRpcRequestDynamicMessageBuilder
methods.description: Creates a dynamic message builder for RPC request schema.

methods.name: getDeviceRpcResponseProtoSchema
methods.description: Returns the RPC response protobuf schema, or a default if not set.

methods.name: getDeviceRpcRequestProtoSchema
methods.description: Returns the RPC request protobuf schema, or a default if not set.
